enforcedBy: the naming gate, which refuses a filename whose last segment before the extension is an undeclared tag or differs from its folder's tag

check.population: every filename whose concern slot holds the tag, and the folder holding each such file
check.freshness: a verdict stands until a file carrying the tag is created, moved or renamed, or the declared vocabulary changes
check.refusal: the lint run fails a file whose tag is undeclared or disagrees with its folder
check.observation: each filename parsed by position against the declared concern vocabulary
check.evidence: fires-and-accepts: a suite lints a file whose tag is undeclared and one whose tag differs from its folder, and passes a conforming file
check.authority: the declared concern vocabulary, which a filename's tag and its folder conform to

records.name: Model Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds a conceptual representation of what the system is about, filed in a models folder.

records.name: Entity Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a domain object with an identity that persists while its attributes change, filed in an entities folder.

records.name: Value-Object Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a domain value compared by its contents rather than by an identity, filed in a value-objects folder.

records.name: Aggregate Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a cluster of domain objects changed together through one root, filed in an aggregates folder.

records.name: Invariant Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that states a property the domain must keep true across every change, filed in an invariants folder.

records.name: Rule Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds one business or governance rule as a unit, filed in a rules folder.

records.name: Constraint Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that declares a limit a domain value or operation must stay within, filed in a constraints folder.

records.name: Domain-Event Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines something meaningful that happened in the domain, filed in a domain-events folder.

records.name: Specification Tag

distinctFrom.reason: A specification only declares a required state or rule as data, while a behavior decides what an agent does next.
A specification is the description of required behavior, while the specification tag names the file concern that declares one as data.
A specification declares a rule other code evaluates, while a template declares a shape whose slots are filled.

records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that declares a required end state or a selection rule as data other code evaluates, filed in a specifications folder.

records.name: Policy Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that chooses among admissible behaviors by a stated rule, filed in a policies folder.

records.name: Use-Case Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that carries one interaction the system offers from its trigger to its outcome, filed in a use-cases folder.

records.name: Resource Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines an addressable piece of data the system exposes or consumes, filed in a resources folder.

records.name: Record Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one structured entry of data with named fields, filed in a records folder.

records.name: Payload Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines the body a message or request carries, filed in a payloads folder.

records.name: Envelope Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines the wrapper carrying a payload's routing and metadata, filed in an envelopes folder.

records.name: Collection Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a grouped set of domain members and the operations over the set, filed in a collections folder.

records.name: Buffer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds data temporarily between a producer and a consumer, filed in a buffers folder.

records.name: Snapshot Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that captures the state of something at one moment so it can be read or restored later, filed in a snapshots folder.

records.name: Checkpoint Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that records a point a long process can resume from, filed in a checkpoints folder.

records.name: Event Tag

distinctFrom.reason: Events are the records of what happened, while the event tag names the file concern that defines one.

records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a notification of something that happened, filed in an events folder.

records.name: Projection Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that derives a read model from a stream of events, filed in a projections folder.

records.name: Level Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one stage of a world a simulation or game advances through, filed in a levels folder.

records.name: Wave Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one timed group of arrivals within a level, filed in a waves folder.

records.name: Progression Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines how a participant advances through unlocks and thresholds, filed in a progression folder.

records.name: Quest Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one objective with its conditions and its reward, filed in a quests folder.

records.name: Achievement Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a recognized milestone and the condition that grants it, filed in an achievements folder.

records.name: Skill Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one ability a participant can train and use, filed in a skills folder.

records.name: Inventory Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines what a participant holds and the rules for adding and removing it, filed in an inventories folder.

records.name: Item Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one kind of object a participant can own or use, filed in an items folder.

records.name: Pickup Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines an object placed in a world that grants something when collected, filed in a pickups folder.

records.name: Drop-Table Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines the weighted outcomes a source can yield, filed in a drop-tables folder.

records.name: Shop Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines an exchange of currency for items with its stock and prices, filed in a shops folder.

records.name: Currency Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a unit of value participants earn and spend, filed in a currencies folder.

records.name: Reward Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines what a participant receives for completing something, filed in a rewards folder.
